# Zhengbiao Anti-Counterfeit Stickers

> > Shenzhen Zhengbiao Anti-Counterfeit Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in hologram stickers, QR code security labels, and scratch card solutions for product authentication and brand protection.

Zhengbiao (zbfwsticker.com) provides advanced anti-counterfeiting technologies including 3D hologram stickers, QR code holographic labels, and custom security solutions for industries ranging from pharmaceuticals to electronics and fashion. The company focuses on reducing revenue loss from counterfeit products through innovative security printing and authentication technologies.

- Holographic applications
